title: A realization weak equivalence between Kan complexes has a simplicial homotopy inverse
statement: Use small simplicial sets, Kan complexes, standard simplices and geometric realization of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a map of Kan complexes whose realization induces a bijection on path components and isomorphisms on all based homotopy groups at every basepoint of $|A|$. Then there exist a simplicial map $g:B\to A$ and simplicial maps $H:A\times\Delta^1\to A$ and $J:B\times\Delta^1\to B$ such that $H|_{A\times\{0\}}=gf$, $H|_{A\times\{1\}}=\mathrm{id}_A$, $J|_{B\times\{0\}}=fg$ and $J|_{B\times\{1\}}=\mathrm{id}_B$. Neither connectedness nor nonemptiness is required.
